text_blocks.snippet: Guaranteed life insurance, also known as guaranteed acceptance or guaranteed issue life insurance, is a type of policy that doesn't require medical exams or health questions, making it easier to obtain coverage, especially for those with pre-existing conditions. However, this ease of access comes with trade-offs, including potentially higher premiums and a waiting period before the full death benefit is paid out.
Key Features of Guaranteed Life Insurance:

list.title: No Medical Exam or Health Questions:
list.snippet: This is the primary advantage, making it accessible to individuals who might be declined for traditional life insurance.

list.title: Higher Premiums:
list.snippet: Due to the lack of health assessment, premiums are typically higher than those for traditional policies with similar coverage.
